definitions.explanation: A portion of the total price paid before the goods or services are delivered, with the balance settled later. Unlike a deposit securing a contract, it counts directly against the amount owed.

examples.japanese: {内金|うちきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put down a part payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{内金|うちきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid half the price as a part payment.

examples.japanese: {内金|うちきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{時点|じてん}→時点：12970_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おきます。
examples.english: We will set the item aside as soon as we receive the part payment.

notes:
Money paid toward a price before delivery. The amount is deducted from the final bill, so it is always part of the price rather than an extra charge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内金|うちきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put down a part payment
- {内金|うちきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay part of the price up front
- {内金|うちきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a part payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手付金|てつけきん}→手付金：29465_tetsukekin⟧: deposit — secures a contract and can be forfeited if the buyer withdraws
- ⟦{頭金|あたまきん}→頭金：29480_atamakin⟧: down payment — the first, larger payment in an installment purchase
- ⟦{前払金|まえばらいきん}→前払金：30222_maebaraikin⟧: advance payment — money paid ahead of delivery, often the full amount
